ignorePatterns:
bun.lock
Cargo.lock
evals/uv.lock
rust/wasm/pkg/**
rust/wasm/pkg-node/**
rust/crates/timeline/tests/fixtures/**
apps/web/src/lib/ai/grades.ts
**/.next/**
**/node_modules/**
target/**
instructions: Mangocut is an AI-first video editor (fork of OpenCut v0.3.0). Business logic is migrating into rust/ (the single source of truth); apps/web (Next.js) and apps/electron are UI shells. Timeline edits go through the Rust crate rust/crates/timeline via wasm (apply_op), and must stay at parity with the frozen TypeScript commands that generate the golden fixtures. The AI agent edits a shadow 'AI changes' timeline that the user merges or discards; agent tools are registered in apps/web/src/lib/commands-api. Agent runs are traced to a local Langfuse (apps/web/src/lib/ai/observability) and scored by DeepEval (evals/). Flag real bugs and contract breaks over style.

rules.rule: Platform-agnostic business logic (timeline operations, validation, time math) belongs in rust/, not in React components, hooks or Electron code. Flag new non-UI logic added under apps/ when an equivalent belongs in a Rust crate.

Rust timeline ops must never generate ids; callers pass new_ids, consumed in order, and running out is a TimelineError with code missing_ids. Ops must return typed TimelineError values (code, message, hint) and never panic on op input: no unwrap/expect/indexing that can fail across the wasm boundary.

Tick values (startTime, duration, trimStart, trimEnd, sourceDuration) are the Ticks newtype over f64 and must round-trip the exact JSON number; do not round on load and do not change float math in ops without regenerating and checking the parity goldens.

Golden fixtures are generated from the frozen legacy TypeScript commands in apps/web/scripts/timeline-parity/legacy. Flag changes that make the harness use the wasm-backed commands (Rust compared with itself) or edit golden JSON by hand.

Agent tool handlers must report failures as { ok: false, reason, error: { code, message, hint } } and never claim success for an edit the engine rejected. Results of edits should describe the resulting state (ids, start, duration, track) so the model can verify it.

ShadowManager.runOnShadow is serialized. Do not call it (or executeCommand with target 'shadow') from inside a shadow run, and do not run shadow commands with Promise.all; overlapping runs overwrite the AI Preview.

Secrets (OpenRouter key, Langfuse secret key, Better Auth secrets) must stay server-side. Renderer and client components must not import @langfuse/* or OpenTelemetry packages, read secret env vars, or use NEXT_PUBLIC_ for secrets.

Tracing must be a no-op when LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY / LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY / LANGFUSE_BASE_URL are unset, must never throw into request handling, and must not delay responses beyond a short bounded flush.
User-facing text, URLs and assets use the Mangocut brand. 'OpenCut' may appear only in the opencut-wasm package alias, upstream attribution, and the LICENSE copyright notice (required by MIT).
